name: track_shipment
description: Return carrier, tracking number, status, estimated delivery and the scan history for a shipment. Takes either a shipment_id or an order_id, and exactly one is required. An order that has not shipped yet has no shipment and is reported as not_found rather than as an empty record.

order_id.description: Order identifier, e.g. W00042. Resolved to that order's shipment.

error_returns.when: Neither shipment_id nor order_id was supplied.
The shipment or order does not exist. Delivery estimates are timestamps.
